column1: # Name lists for the Tier 2 languages: our own, written from general knowledge of common names and forms of address. They are lists of
# common words, not records: given names and family names are drawn independently, so no string is a real person's name by construction.
# lang <TAB> kind <TAB> comma-separated items. Kinds: givenM, givenF, family (a leading particle goes in the particle kind), title, particle,
# prof (professional suffix), conn (the word that joins two people: "Anna und Peter Weber"), unknown (strings that are neither person nor company),
# order (given-first or family-first for the plain form of the language).
